title: send_request double-serializes: to_value then to_string
description: WsSession::send_request calls serde_json::to_value(req) to get a Value, mutates it to insert @type and optional id, then calls serde_json::to_string(&val). The to_value call allocates a full serde_json::Value tree (heap-allocating Strings for every field, Vecs for arrays). For a JmapRequest with multiple method calls and large argument objects, this is a significant allocation. The to_string call then re-encodes the same tree. Alternative: a wrapper struct with #[serde(flatten)] that adds @type and id fields: struct WsRequestFrame<'a> { @type: &'static str, #[serde(skip_serializing_if)] id: Option<&'a str>, #[serde(flatten)] inner: &'a JmapRequest } — serializes in one pass with no intermediate Value.
